learning_objectives.en: Predict place nouns and follow route language while avoiding old-versus-new distractors.
learning_objectives.vi: Dự đoán danh từ địa điểm, theo chỉ dẫn và tránh bẫy vị trí cũ/mới.

theory.title: Map listening without the original book audio

content.en: Listen to the original independent practice track for Kelby station. Orient yourself at the main entrance. An old location may be mentioned and then corrected: the most recent correct information matters.
content.vi: Nghe bài luyện Kelby độc lập, xác định điểm đứng ở cổng chính. Vị trí cũ có thể được nhắc rồi sửa; đáp án là vị trí hiện tại.

strategies.en: Read every question and predict a place, floor, direction or duration. Listen for but/now/instead to detect corrections.
strategies.vi: Đọc câu hỏi, đoán nơi, tầng, hướng hay thời lượng. Chú ý but/now/instead khi sửa thông tin.

common_mistakes.wrong: The ticket office is on the left because the guide says “used to”.
common_mistakes.correct: The ticket office is straight ahead, at the back of the main hall.

reason.en: “Used to” introduces outdated information; “now” gives the answer.
reason.vi: Used to là vị trí cũ; now mới là đáp án.

mini_review.en: Can you label six locations from the recording without re-reading the transcript?
mini_review.vi: Bạn xác định được sáu vị trí sau khi nghe mà không xem lời thoại?

audios.title: Listening: Finding your way around Kelby station
audios.transcript:
Guide: Welcome to Kelby station. I’m going to explain where everything is, starting from where we’re standing now, at the main entrance, facing into the station.
The ticket office used to be on your left as you came in, but it’s been moved. It’s now straight ahead of you, at the back of the main hall, between the two staircases.
If you need help, the information desk is just inside the entrance on your right, so it’s the first thing you pass.
For food, there’s a café in the north-west corner of the hall – that’s to your far left – and a small supermarket opposite it, in the north-east corner.
The toilets are downstairs. Take the left-hand staircase, and you’ll find them at the bottom, next to the lifts.
Platforms one and two are reached by the left-hand staircase as well, while platforms three and four are reached by the staircase on the right.
Now, outside. When you leave by the main entrance, the new bus station is directly in front of you, under the glass roof. Taxis wait to the right of the bus station, along the side of the square.
The cycle store is to the left of the entrance as you go out, next to the ticket machines on the outside wall. You need a membership card to open it; cards can be bought at the information desk.
Finally, if you’re walking into town, cross the square to the pedestrian crossing in the far corner, and follow the footpath along the canal. It’s about a twelve-minute walk.
